---
title: "NBA Shot Selection Analysis"
---

## Overview

This package provides tools to scrape and explore the NBA Shot Selection from the nba_api. This automates the collection, cleaning, analysis, and visualization of the change in NBA player shot selection from the 2010 to the end of the 2023 season.

Check out this streamlit app to explore the findings [here](https://nbaapi-project-iktjrcqcxerwx6xqe9atg9.streamlit.app/)
